nodes.summary: The conductance `φ(S) = w(∂S) / min(d(S), d(V \ S))` of a vertex set in a weighted graph and the hard direction of Cheeger's inequality: from any vector `z` with small Rayleigh quotient `zᵀLz / zᵀDz` a threshold cut `{a : z(a) < τ}` has conductance at most `√(2 zᵀLz / zᵀDz)` (D. A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, Chapter 21, following Trevisan). Both directions are proved: the easy direction…
nodes.title: Conductance and Cheeger's inequality

nodes.summary: A graph is vertex-transitive when its automorphism group acts transitively on vertices.
nodes.title: Vertex-transitive graph

nodes.summary: A graph `H` is a spectral approximation of `G` when `L_G ≼ L_H ≼ κ L_G` in the Loewner order, so that every Laplacian quadratic form, and hence every eigenvalue and cut, is preserved up to `κ`. Batson, Spielman and Srivastava showed that `O(n)` edges suffice, through a barrier argument that the Marcus–Spielman–Srivastava proof of Kadison–Singer later refined.
nodes.title: Spectral sparsification

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
